greeting: Good morning, Zuhair. Grab a coffee — it's a big weekend for AI and for Victorian politics.

lead.headline: Anthropic lists on Nasdaq in the largest IPO on record
lead.summary: Anthropic priced its shares at $83 and raised about $81 billion, topping the previous record set by SpaceX. The stock jumped on debut, though the wider tech sector has since had a rough week.

stories.headline: Agentic AI system designed to discover synthesizable metal–organic frameworks
stories.summary: Published in Nature Computational Science on 20 Nov, the paper from Yaghi's group describes MOFGen, which chains language, diffusion and quantum-chemistry agents to propose materials that can actually be made. It is drawing attention as an example of AI agents doing real lab-linked discovery.

stories.headline: Large language models for computational social science
stories.summary: A review in Nature Human Behaviour (online 26 Oct, November issue) maps how LLMs are used as simulated subjects, analysis assistants and hypothesis generators in social-science research.

stories.headline: Networks of LLM agents can spontaneously polarize
stories.summary: Nature Communications published (version of record 6 Nov) a study showing that groups of interacting language-model agents drift into polarized opinions, offering a synthetic testbed for opinion dynamics.

stories.headline: Anthropic's record IPO collides with tech's worst week since 2020
stories.summary: Despite the blockbuster listing, a broad tech sell-off dragged on markets this week, leaving the AI trade under pressure.

stories.headline: Anthropic's IPO puts AI's circular financing boom to the test
stories.summary: TechCrunch looks at how money flowing between AI labs, chipmakers and cloud providers is being tested now that a major lab is publicly traded.

stories.headline: Anthropic raises $81.3bn in biggest IPO of all time
stories.summary: Al Jazeera reports on the pricing and proceeds of the listing, which surpassed SpaceX's earlier record offering.

stories.headline: Man in hospital after stabbing in Melbourne CBD
stories.summary: A 24-year-old was seriously injured in a stabbing on Bourke Street Mall, and police are seeking a man over the attack.

stories.headline: Fourth Melbourne Cup revealed stolen as accused appear in court
stories.summary: Two men have been charged over thefts of several Melbourne Cups and a Caulfield Cup from racecourses.

stories.headline: Melbourne teacher pleads guilty over hidden camera in school toilets
stories.summary: A primary school teacher admitted 13 charges and will face a pre-sentence hearing in May.

stories.headline: Victoria Election 2026: one week to go
stories.summary: With the state election on 28 November, ABC's coverage tracks polling that experts say points to a heavy loss for Labor.

stories.headline: Iran war live: US denies Iranian claim it struck an F-16 over the Gulf
stories.summary: The US military rejected Iran's claim of hitting a fighter jet as the conflict and the stalled push to end it continue.

stories.headline: Rescue under way as drones hit Russian ship off Finland
stories.summary: A Kaliningrad-bound cargo ship was struck in the Gulf of Finland, and Finnish forces said Ukraine was likely responsible.

thought: The best way to predict the future is to invent it. — Alan Kay
